boards.title: Your First Weekend at Cal Poly Maritime Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Saturday-to-Sunday sequence for getting oriented to the waterfront campus, trying core student spaces, and exploring Vallejo’s maritime setting.

cards.title: Saturday Morning: Learn Your Residence Hall
cards.subtitle: Begin where many first-year students live
cards.notes: Locate the Residence Life office and save its contact details, then learn the approved entrances and shared-space expectations for your assigned hall.
cards.short_summary: Start the weekend by understanding the residential resources available to new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies McAllister Residence Hall as suite-style housing that primarily accommodates first-year students; the Residence Life office is in Upper Residence Hall.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Residence halls are student housing, not public attractions. Enter only your assigned hall or spaces where a resident or university staff member authorizes access.

cards.title: Saturday Brunch: Test the Marketplace Routine
cards.subtitle: Practice a normal weekend meal stop
cards.notes: Bring your campus payment method, scan the posted menu, and ask dining staff about ingredients or dietary needs before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: Use an early meal to learn how weekend campus dining works before classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Marketplace Dining Center as its campus dining venue and states that weekend service runs from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: FAQ Dining & Cooking | California State University Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: The cited legacy dining page lists Saturday and Sunday hours of 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; verify posted hours because academic breaks and campus integration may affect service.

cards.title: Saturday Midday: Map Your Student-Service Hub
cards.subtitle: Find the offices you may need later
cards.notes: Walk through authorized common areas and note where the Registrar, Admissions, Financial Aid, Career Services, and student gathering spaces are located.
cards.short_summary: Turn Mayo Hall into a familiar reference point for future administrative questions.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says renovated Mayo Hall contains lounges, study and leadership spaces plus student services including the Registrar, Admissions, Financial Aid and Career Services.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project | Cal Maritime
cards.access_notes: Use public or student-authorized common areas only. Individual offices generally operate on weekday schedules and may be closed during a weekend visit.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Preview the Library
cards.subtitle: Identify a future research and study base
cards.notes: Check the live calendar before leaving your residence hall, then locate service points and choose a study area that suits quiet or collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Learn the library layout now so the first assignment does not become a navigation exercise.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that the Cal Maritime Library serves the Solano campus and Maritime Academy with research resources, services and collaborative learning environments.
cards.source_title: Maritime Academy and Solano Campus | Robert E. Kennedy Library
cards.access_notes: Consult the linked Solano Campus Library Hours calendar before visiting; weekend availability varies by date and academic calendar.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: See the Training Ship
cards.subtitle: View the academy’s primary training platform
cards.notes: Observe the ship only from an authorized public campus viewpoint, read its role in Sea Term, and leave gangways and working areas to approved personnel.
cards.short_summary: Connect the waterfront setting with the academy’s shipboard training mission.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Training Ship Golden Bear as the primary platform where cadets apply classroom technology and Corps of Cadets leadership skills.
cards.source_title: Training Ship Golden Bear Summer Sea Term | Cal Maritime
cards.access_notes: Do not board independently. Ship access is limited to authorized activities or appointment-based campus tours when the vessel is available.

cards.title: Saturday Evening: Pause at Morrow Cove
cards.subtitle: Close the campus loop at the waterfront
cards.notes: Use an authorized waterfront area to compare campus landmarks from the shoreline, take a daylight photo, and remain behind all posted barriers.
cards.short_summary: Finish the campus portion of Saturday with a clear mental picture of its waterfront orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: An official university community-engagement page names Morrow Cove as a campus waterfront gathering location and describes activities held there.
cards.access_notes: Use only open, authorized campus areas. Waterfront conditions and university operations may restrict access; obey barriers and posted instructions.

cards.title: Sunday Morning: Check the PEAC Setup
cards.subtitle: Learn where campus recreation happens
cards.notes: Bring your PortPass, inspect posted student-use rules, and identify the weight, cardio, gym, and pool areas before planning a later workout.
cards.short_summary: Use a low-pressure orientation stop to understand the academy’s principal recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The university documents the PEAC as an athletic complex with an Olympic-size heated outdoor pool, indoor basketball court and auxiliary gym spaces.
cards.access_notes: Student access, weekend hours, PortPass requirements and pool availability are not established by this page; check current campus postings before entering or exercising.

cards.title: Sunday Alternative: Shift the Museum to Saturday
cards.subtitle: Add local context when the museum is open
cards.notes: Schedule this for Saturday, show student identification for the posted student rate, and examine exhibits connecting Vallejo with Mare Island’s naval history.
cards.short_summary: Place the academy’s maritime surroundings within Vallejo’s wider civic and naval story.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum documents five galleries about Vallejo and Mare Island naval history, Saturday hours of 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. and $3 student admission.
cards.source_title: About Us | Vallejo Naval & Historical Museum
cards.access_notes: Closed Sunday and Monday. Visit Tuesday–Friday from noon–4:00 p.m. or Saturday from 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Sunday Midday: Learn the Ferry Gateway
cards.subtitle: Practice reading Vallejo’s regional transit options
cards.notes: Locate the terminal entrance, compare the posted weekend departures with the live service page, and save the route-alert link for future trips.
cards.short_summary: Gain familiarity with a practical regional connection without committing to a full-day excursion.
cards.evidence_claim: San Francisco Bay Ferry identifies Vallejo Ferry Terminal at 289 Mare Island Way and provides daily service to San Francisco with select Mare Island trips.
cards.source_title: Vallejo Ferry Terminal | San Francisco Bay Ferry
cards.access_notes: The terminal can be explored without boarding, but travel requires a valid fare. Check real-time departures and alerts because schedules can change.

cards.title: Sunday Afternoon: Walk Mare Island Preserve
cards.subtitle: End with a marked public trail outing
cards.notes: Check current city access notices, arrive well before closing, stay on designated paths, carry water, and turn back if weather or conditions deteriorate.
cards.short_summary: Conclude the weekend with a daylight walk through Vallejo’s public maritime landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Vallejo describes Mare Island Preserve as public parkland with roughly 124 acres and states that it is open daily from 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Mare Island Preserve | City of Vallejo
cards.access_notes: The city page lists daily access from 6:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m. and capacity limits. Verify current fire, restoration and security notices before departure.
